description: Emails a Lamoi site sends to its own customers (serviceId from oma_waas_sites). get: how they leave (lamoi = our mail with the site's name and design, own = the owner's SMTP server, tested), design switch, fallback, and the saved server without its password. log: the delivery log (sent / failed, addresses hidden). Writes need confirm: set (mode lamoi|own, brand true|false, fallback true|false, smtp {host, port 465|587|2525|25, user, from, fromName, provider google|microsoft|brevo|mailgun|sendgrid|postmark|other}; switching to own tests the connection first and stays on our mail if it fails), check (tests the saved server's connection without sending), test (sends a test mail to the site admin address). The SMTP password is never set here: the owner types it on the site under Look, Email. DNS records for the owner's domain are shown on the same screen; this tool changes no DNS and no mail server.

action.description: get (default) and log are reads; set, check and test need confirm.

brand.description: set: the site's design on all plain site emails.

fallback.description: set: if the owner's server fails, send through our mail.

mode.description: set: lamoi = our mail with the site's name and design, own = the owner's SMTP server (tested first).

serviceId.description: The Lamoi site's service id (from oma_waas_sites).

smtp.description: set: the owner's mail server. The password is never set here: the owner types it on the site (Look, Email).

name: oma_waas_email
title: Lamoi site emails
